twitch_get_user_by_username {"someone": {"id": 1234, "login": "someone", "display_name": "Someone"}, "foobar": {"id": 1, "login": "foobar"}}


handle hortbot hortbot/2 admin/7 access=admin :!admin block
send hortbot #hortbot [HB] Usage: !admin block <username>

handle hortbot hortbot/2 admin/7 access=admin :!admin block nobody
send hortbot #hortbot [HB] Error getting ID from Twitch: twitch: unexpected status: 404

handle hortbot hortbot/2 admin/7 access=admin :!admin unblock
send hortbot #hortbot [HB] Usage: !admin unblock <username>

handle hortbot hortbot/2 admin/7 access=admin :!admin unblock nobody
send hortbot #hortbot [HB] Error getting ID from Twitch: twitch: unexpected status: 404


handle hortbot hortbot/2 admin/7 access=admin :!admin block foobar
send hortbot #hortbot [HB] foobar (1) has been blocked.
no_notify_eventsub_updates

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command
no_send


handle hortbot hortbot/2 admin/7 access=admin :!join foobar
no_send

handle hortbot hortbot/2 foobar/1 :!join
no_send


join hortbot 2 someone 1234

handle hortbot someone/1234 someone/1234 :!command
send_any

handle hortbot hortbot/2 admin/7 access=admin :!admin block someone
send hortbot #hortbot [HB] Someone (1234) has been blocked.
notify_eventsub_updates

handle hortbot someone/1234 someone/1234 :!command
no_send


handle hortbot hortbot/2 admin/7 access=admin :!admin unblock someone
send hortbot #hortbot [HB] Someone (1234) has been unblocked.
no_notify_eventsub_updates

join hortbot 2 someone 1234

handle hortbot someone/1234 someone/1234 :!command
send_any
